description: Streamer DeenTheGreat, whose real name is Nurideen Shabazz, is facing felony robbery and misdemeanor battery charges linked to an alleged yacht incident in Miami. If convicted, he could face up to 15 years in prison. His lawyer says prosecutors are expected to dismiss the case soon, but the charges remain active ahead of his August 4 court hearing.
title: DeenTheGreat's lawyer makes fresh claim amid 15-year prison risk

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Kantara star Rishab Shetty shared his appreciation for the Ramayana-The Introduction trailer. He lauded the film's convincing cinematic world and the team's efforts. Shetty also praised the cast for their responsible portrayal of iconic mythological figures. He highlighted Ranbir Kapoor's divine presence and Yash's impactful performance as Raavana. The music by A.R. Rahman and Hans Zimmer further elevated the trailer's emotions.
title: Rishab Shetty lauds Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana' trailer

author: DIPAK K DASH
description: Government ministries have offered varied figures regarding fuel efficiency changes.  Older vehicles using E20 fuel may see a slight mileage reduction.  The Road Transport Ministry cited a 2-6% potential decrease in efficiency.  The Petroleum Ministry indicated a general reduction of about 3-5%.  Both ministries stressed that fuel economy depends on driving and maintenance factors.
title: Mileage drop due to E20? 2-6%, says 1 minister, 3-5%, says another

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ajinkya Rahane represented India in 85 Tests, scoring 5,077 runs, including 12 centuries and 26 fifties, at an average of 38.46. In ODIs, he played 90 matches and scored 2,962 runs, with three centuries and 24 fifties at an average of 35.26. In T20Is, Rahane featured in 20 matches and scored 375 runs, including one half-century.
title: 'We've shared dressing room for so many years': Rohit's heartfelt note for Rahane

author: CHITTARANJAN TEMBHEKAR AND GAURAV TALWAR
description: India's July monsoon rainfall exceeded expectations, defying earlier forecasts of below-normal precipitation.  This unexpected recovery eased fears of a significant monsoon shortfall for the nation.  However, rainfall distribution remained uneven across different regions of the country.  Experts now emphasize that El Nino alone cannot explain India's changing rainfall behaviour.  Climate change is increasingly altering monsoon patterns, making predictions more complex.
title: ‘Normal’ July rain defies forecast of El Nino impact

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Neeraj Chopra will compete in the Commonwealth Games 2026 javelin final on August 1. He qualified with a throw of 79.61m amidst difficult stadium conditions. Chopra faces strong competition from Arshad Nadeem and Keshorn Walcott. The final will be held at Scotstoun Stadium in Glasgow, Scotland. Fans can watch the event live on Sony Sports channels and SonyLIV.
title: When is Neeraj Chopra's CWG 2026 javelin final? All you need to know

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
description: The Supreme Court questioned Parliament's decision to exclude the Chief Justice of India from the selection panel.  Justices noted the CJI's inclusion in other key appointment committees.  The court heard arguments challenging the 2023 Act's appointment process.  The government urged the court not to question legislative wisdom.  The bench clarified it was not questioning the Prime Minister's trustworthiness.
title: Why’s CJI not on panel to pick CEC, Supreme Court asks government

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A new study has claimed that between 2,000 and 5,000 metric tons of undeclared uranium may have been extracted and exported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) between 2000 and 2024 through the country's cobalt supply chain, despite the nation not officially reporting uranium production for decades. The research, published in Nature Communications, was conducted by scientists from the University of Wisconsin–Madison and Princeton University.
title: Study: 5k tons of undeclared uranium may have entered China via DR

author: TNN
description: Rajya Sabha saw a political storm after Mallikarjun Kharge questioned Amit Shah's absence and silence.  He clarified his remarks meant people's power for accountability, not physical force.  Opposition MPs questioned the effectiveness of the new anti-paper leak bill.  Several parties demanded the government scrap the NEET exam.  The debate highlighted ongoing concerns about student protests and exam integrity.
title: Despite unrest, PM Modi, Amit Shah haven't spoken on NEET protests: Opposition

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Dwyane Wade and Gabrielle Union have been through a lot in their marriage as the actres opens up about the darkest phase of their marriage.
title: Gabrielle Union reveals why she nearly walked away from Dwyane Wade

author: TNN
description: Formal retail credit penetration in India more than doubled over the past decade.  Consumption-led lending, including personal loans, drove this significant growth.  Credit access expanded to younger borrowers and women across India.  Northern and central states saw increased credit activity, while western and southern regions moderated.  This shift reflects credit being used for lifestyle rather than asset acquisition.
title: Formal retail credit access doubles over past decade

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Thalapathy Vijay's Jana Nayagan saw collections decrease on its eighth day. The film's India net total reached over 153 crore rupees. Worldwide gross collections for Jana Nayagan have now surpassed 260 crore. The Tamil version continues to be the primary revenue driver. Collections are following an expected weekday trend after its opening.
title: 'Jana Nayagan' BO day 8: Thalapathy Vijay's film earns Rs 3.98 crore

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Watch: Thousands of Moroccan migrants flood into Spain; videos go viral

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Actor-entrepreneur Vivek Oberoi has opened up about the setbacks that pushed him to reinvent himself beyond acting, saying he refused to become a "victim" when opportunities dried up. Reflecting on his entrepreneurial journey, he recalled how his business partner rebuilt his life after suffering losses exceeding Rs 100 crore. Oberoi also shared how meeting an eight-month-old leukemia patient named Sahara during Saathiya inspired his lifelong commitment to helping children battling cancer.
title: Vivek Oberoi recalls partner saving baby with leukemia as life's biggest reward
